title: Friends Gathering at Indoor Living Room Party, 1966 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot photo stamped April 1966 capturing a casual indoor gathering or cocktail party in a mid-century living room. Guests styled with classic 1960s bouffant hairstyles and semi-formal attire relax around a table with drinks, surrounded by period decor including tall lampshades, heavy drapes, and an arched entry.
